title: Digital Marketing & Growth Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Uless is a digital savings and discounts platform that helps consumers discover deals, discounts, promotions, and special offers from leading brands across fashion, technology, travel, subscriptions, lifestyle, and more. Uless brings valuable savings together in one convenient platform, making it easier for consumers to discover trusted offers without searching across multiple websites. Verified students can unlock additional student\-exclusive discounts and benefits, giving them even more opportunities to save. Uless also helps brands reach and acquire new customers through digital marketing, affiliate partnerships, and targeted promotional campaigns. The company is building a trusted global savings ecosystem where consumers can discover better deals and make smarter spending decisions every day.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Digital Marketing \& Social Media Growth Manager is a
 **full\-time, remote role based in India** 
 . This role is responsible for developing and executing digital marketing and social media growth strategies that increase brand awareness, website traffic, user acquisition, engagement, conversions, and revenue for Uless. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include managing social media channels, developing content calendars, creating and publishing engaging content, identifying emerging trends, and optimizing campaigns for growth and performance. The role involves managing organic and paid campaigns, monitoring analytics, supporting SEO and content marketing initiatives, developing influencer and creator partnerships, and testing new platforms, content formats, audiences, and marketing strategies to increase reach and conversions. The manager will work closely with product, partnerships, and other teams remotely to support campaign launches, promote brand offers, strengthen customer acquisition, and maintain consistent Uless messaging across all digital touchpoints. A key focus of the role will be turning social media and digital audiences into website visitors, registered users, customers, and measurable revenue growth.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong social media marketing and social media optimization (SMO) skills, with hands\-on experience growing and engaging audiences across major platforms such as Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
* Excellent communication, copywriting, and storytelling skills, with the ability to create clear, compelling, and brand\-aligned content for both general consumers and student audiences.
* Experience developing and executing digital marketing and growth strategies focused on increasing website traffic, user acquisition, engagement, conversions, and revenue.
* Experience with content strategy, including planning content calendars, defining content themes, creating campaigns, and aligning content with marketing and business objectives.
* Familiarity with digital marketing tools and analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, SEO tools, email marketing platforms, and social media analytics.
* Understanding of SEO, paid advertising, performance marketing, conversion optimization, affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, and customer acquisition strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze marketing data, track key performance indicators, identify growth opportunities, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Ability to develop and manage multiple marketing campaigns, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a fast\-paced remote startup environment.
* Strong understanding of consumer behavior, digital trends, social media algorithms, and emerging content formats.
* Ability to identify relevant influencers, creators, publishers, and partnership opportunities and help develop campaigns that generate measurable traffic and conversions.
* Understanding of student demographics and trends, with the ability to develop campaigns that encourage verified students to discover and use additional student\-exclusive discounts.
* Creative, entrepreneurial, and growth\-oriented mindset with a willingness to experiment, test new ideas, and continuously optimize marketing performance.
* Strong ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams using digital communication and project management tools.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–5 years of prior experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, social media management, performance marketing, or a related field. Experience with consumer, e\-commerce, marketplace, affiliate, or youth\-focused brands is highly beneficial.


-

title: Affiliate Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Uless is a digital savings platform that connects consumers with discounts, deals, offers, and promotions from leading brands across fashion, technology, travel, subscriptions, education, lifestyle, and everyday essentials. The platform centralizes a wide range of brand offers, making it easy for users to discover curated savings in one place instead of searching multiple websites. Uless enables brands to reach new audiences through digital marketing and affiliate partnerships, creating value for both consumers and businesses. Students can access additional student\-focused deals by verifying their status with a valid .edu email, unlocking savings tailored to the student community. The mission at Uless is to make saving simpler and more accessible for everyone while helping brands connect with the right audiences.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Affiliate Marketing Manager is a full\-time remote role responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing Uless’s affiliate partner network. This role includes identifying and onboarding new affiliate partners, nurturing existing relationships, and coordinating campaigns that drive traffic, conversions, and revenue. The manager will monitor performance metrics, analyze data, and provide regular reporting and insights to guide strategy and improve results. Day\-to\-day activities involve collaborating with marketing and sales teams on promotional plans, negotiating partner terms, ensuring compliance with brand guidelines, and testing new approaches to maximize partner and user value. The role also requires staying current with affiliate marketing trends and competitive activity to inform ongoing program improvements.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Affiliate Management and Affiliate Marketing skills, including experience building and optimizing affiliate programs.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, with the ability to manage partner relationships and collaborate across internal teams.
* Candidates should possess Marketing skills, including campaign planning, performance analysis, and familiarity with digital marketing channels.
* Candidates should possess Sales\-related skills, such as negotiation, prospecting, and closing partnership opportunities.
* Experience with performance tracking tools, analytics platforms, and affiliate networks or SaaS marketing tools is beneficial.
* Relevant experience in e\-commerce, savings platforms, or digital marketplaces is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results on deadline.
* 2–5 years of prior experience in affiliate marketing is highly beneficial.

title: SEO / AEO Specialist
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking an analytical, detail\-oriented SEO / AEO Specialist to grow our organic search visibility and traffic from one of our India office locations. You will own hands\-on execution across keyword research, on\-page and technical optimisation, and content collaboration, while tracking performance and translating data into clear recommendations.
   

  

 This is an execution\-focused role. The Web Strategy Manager sets overall search direction and priorities; you own the day\-to\-day work that delivers against them. You will work closely with content, web development, and demand generation teams to ensure our site is discoverable, fast, and well\-structured for both traditional search engines and emerging AI\-driven answer experiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Technical \& On\-Page SEO**
* Perform technical SEO audits covering site speed, crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data, and mobile usability, and partner with the web development team to resolve issues.
* Optimise existing pages and new content for on\-page best practices including titles, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, and schema markup.
* Partner with the web team to ensure site changes and new page launches follow SEO best practices before they go live.


**Research, Content \& AEO**
* Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities and content gaps.
* Collaborate with content and marketing teams to plan and brief search\-friendly content that aligns with search intent.
* Apply emerging Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) practices to improve visibility in AI\-driven search surfaces such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.
* Support backlink and digital PR efforts that build domain authority.


**Measurement \& Reporting**
* Monitor and report on organic performance using Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Search Console, and SEO tooling.
* Track rankings, traffic, and conversion trends, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Present regular performance reporting and insight to stakeholders.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Work to the direction and priorities set by the Web Strategy Manager, flagging trade\-offs and opportunities as they arise.
* Partner with web development, design, content, and demand generation teams to get recommendations implemented.
* Stay current on search engine algorithm updates and evolving discoverability practices.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 6–9 years of experience in SEO, digital marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on\-page optimisation, and content strategy.
* Hands\-on experience with Google Analytics (GA4\) and Google Search Console.
* Proficiency with SEO tooling such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Screaming Frog.
* Familiarity with emerging AEO concepts and how AI\-driven search surfaces are changing discoverability.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how site structure impacts search performance.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Excellent written communication skills, and comfort briefing content teams and writing optimised copy.
* Detail\-oriented and organised, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience with Webflow or other content management platforms is preferred.
* Experience with structured data and schema markup implementation is preferred.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistent quarter\-over\-quarter growth in organic traffic and keyword rankings.
* Improved site health scores and a reducing backlog of technical SEO issues.
* Content that ranks well and genuinely satisfies search intent.
* Growing visibility in AI\-driven answer experiences.
* Clear, data\-backed reporting that informs content and web strategy decisions.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Persistence in chasing fixes through to implementation rather than stopping at the recommendation.
* Curiosity about how search is changing, and willingness to test new approaches.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  





  




**Role Overview** 
  


  

 The Principal Product Manager (Marketing) exists to drive JumpCloud's market presence, packaging, and competitive positioning to accelerate global growth. In this high\-impact role, you will lead the strategic alignment of our pricing and packaging models while enabling our global sales team with the tools, positioning, and competitive insights they need to win. Serving as a key evangelist, you will translate complex platform capabilities into compelling market narratives and lead cross\-functional initiatives across sales, product, and go\-to\-market teams. Ultimately, you will solve critical business problems by elevating our thought leadership and scaling our market reach.
 




  




**Employee Value Proposition (EVP)** 
  

  
* **Purpose:** 
 You will shape how the world perceives and adopts JumpCloud’s open directory platform, directly influencing our market share and driving modern identity infrastructure solutions.
  
* **Growth:** 
 You will own major strategic pricing and packaging initiatives, expand your influence across executive\-level steering committees, and establish yourself as a premier industry speaker and evangelist.
  
* **Motivators:** 
 Work autonomously at a high\-velocity, tech\-forward company where you can leverage cutting\-edge AI tools to build processes and drive sales acceleration assets that directly impact revenue.
  

  


  


  




**Major Performance Objectives** 
  


 Measurable outcomes for the first 6\-12 months:
 


  

  
* **6\-Month Integration \& Asset Delivery:** 
 Within the first 6 months, fully integrate into the marketing and product teams to deliver at least 3 high\-value assets and incorporate JumpCloud's thought leadership and positioning across key marketing channels.
  
* **Pricing \& Packaging Strategy:** 
 Within 9 months, analyze, optimize, and roll out an updated pricing and packaging strategy that simplifies customer onboarding and maximizes average contract value (ACV).
  
* **Sales Enablement \& Competitive Differentiation:** 
 By month 12, equip the global sales organization with comprehensive competitive differentiators and positioning assets, resulting in increased win rates against key competitors.
  
* **Platform Evangelism \& Thought Leadership:** 
 Establish yourself as a core external speaker for JumpCloud within 12 months, delivering at least 4 public demos or presentations across multiple platform feature sets.
  
* **AI\-Driven Process Optimization:** 
 Within 12 months, build out and scale at least 2 AI\-leveraged processes or tools to support the marketing team’s execution, while collaborating with the AI steering committee to deploy sales\-driven assets that accelerate deal velocity.
  

  


  


  




**Critical Subtasks:** 
  


 Supporting activities to achieve objectives:
 


  

  
2. **Collaborate** 
 with product management, sales, and executive leadership to audit and refine current pricing and packaging models.
  
4. **Conduct** 
 deep\-dive competitive intelligence research to identify clear market differentiators and map out the competitive landscape.
  
6. **Author** 
 and deliver high\-impact enablement assets (such as pitch decks, battlecards, and demo scripts) for the global sales team.
  
8. **Partner** 
 with the AI steering committee to identify, develop, and deploy AI\-driven assets and workflows that accelerate sales deal cycles.
  
10. **Master** 
 the JumpCloud platform to effortlessly deliver comprehensive, multi\-feature technical demos to customers, partners, and industry analysts.
  
12. **Build and maintain** 
 strong cross\-functional relationships across the sales, product, and go\-to\-market (GTM) motions to ensure unified messaging.
  
14. **Represent** 
 JumpCloud as a speaker and thought leader at industry events, webinars, and executive briefings.
  


  


  




**Required Skills and Experience:** 
  

  
* **Must\-have functional skills:** 



  

	  
	+ Product Marketing and Go\-To\-Market (GTM) strategy execution
	  
	+ Strategic pricing and packaging design for SaaS or platform technologies
	  
	+ Advanced sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and positioning asset creation
  
* **Preferred domain knowledge:** 



  

	  
	+ Identity and Access Management (
	 
	 IAM
	 
	 ), Directory Services, or Cloud Security
	  
	+ SaaS business models and developer/IT buyer personas
  
* **Tools or systems knowledge:** 



  

	  
	+ Modern AI productivity tools and workflow automation platforms
	  
	+ Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM and marketing automation systems
  
* **Behavioral or power skills:** 



  

	  
	+ Exceptional public speaking, storytelling, and evangelism capabilities
	  
	+ Strong cross\-functional collaboration and relationship\-building across sales, product, and GTM teams
	  
	+ High degree of autonomy, strategic thinking, and process\-building capability
  

  


  





  




  


  





**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 



  



 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 



  


  
 


  



**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.** 




  


  
 


  


**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  


  
 


  



 One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  


  
 


  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  


  
 


  



 JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  



**Scam Notice:** 




  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"
 



  


  
 


  



 \#BI\-Remote
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Major Account Manager - Conglomerates
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 Working together with a Solutions Consultant,, you will be responsible for growing your territory. You are the primary point\-of\-contact for India’s one of the largest conglomerate group and are accountable for delivering above quota sales performance in your region. You are motivated by a hunger to solve critically difficult challenges that face our clients. You develop trusted relationships at a high, executive level, focusing on the strategic nature of the partnership. This means that you have a concrete understanding of our product suites, and are able to help identify areas that can be resolved by Palo Alto Networks solutions.
   

  

 You will lead to identifying and signing appropriate channel partners as well as training them on our solutions. Additionally, your credibility will guide your customers in their search to transition to a more secure online environment. You feel empowered by our product offerings \- and love a technical challenge.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* You will specifically be responsible for managing a strategic Conglomerate group
* Employing world\-class account management skills to identify cross\-selling and up\-selling opportunities within the target accounts
* Be a highly competent presenter, with a proven track record in selling to C level executives
* Develop and maintain detailed account profiles including organisational charts for all accounts to be reviewed by management on a quarterly basis
* Facilitate communication on strategic and tactical issues facing our clients and partners
* Maintain continuity and up\-to\-date knowledge of industry trends, technical developments, and governmental regulations that affect target markets
* Develop market strategies and goals for each product and service; understand the strategies, goals, and objectives of accounts
* Lead coordinating account strategy and tactics for sales support team (inside sales, systems engineering, sales management)
* Take full responsibility for accurate sales forecasting by demonstrating in\-depth knowledge of sales cycles from initial contact through the procurement process
* Extensive domestic travel and possible International travel as necessary


**Qualifications**
**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Sri Madhusudan Sai Global Humanitarian Mission passionately provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sri Madhusudan Sai, the organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The Social Media Strategist role will involve crafting impactful campaigns that resonate with our values and vision. By staying abreast of the latest social media trends and technologies, you'll ensure our message reaches the right audience. Collaborating closely with our project and communications teams, you'll help manage our online reputation and leverage data\-driven insights to optimise our social media presence.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Transform our social media presence with groundbreaking strategies that resonate with our audience and powerfully convey our message.
* Collaborate closely with the project and communications teams to create cohesive and impactful social awareness strategies and campaigns.
* Demonstrate expertise in navigating and utilising major social media platforms, including Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, and other popular apps.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest social media trends, technologies, and best practices to ensure the organisation maintains a strong online presence.
* Handle online reputation management and social listening activities to monitor the organisation's brand image and respond to discussions and inquiries.
* Leverage data analytics and insights to measure the performance of social media campaigns, identify opportunities for improvement, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Organise and host external events, such as community events and competitions, to further engage the organisation's online following.
* Continuously explore new and innovative ways to leverage social media to support the organisation's mission and objectives.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in social media strategy, management, and content creation.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful social media campaigns.
* Familiarity with social media management tools and analytics platforms.
* Experience in event planning and community engagement is an added advantage.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Exceptional strategic and creative thinking skills to conceptualise and execute engaging social media campaigns.
* Proficiency in managing and leveraging major social media platforms, including Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Instagram.
* Strong understanding of social media trends, emerging technologies, and best practices.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Data\-driven approach to social media analytics and performance optimisation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to articulate ideas and strategies.
* Proactive and adaptable mindset to respond to changing social media landscape.
* Project management skills and ability to work under tight deadlines.
* Creativity and passion for leveraging social media to drive organisational goals.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience in event planning and community engagement is an added advantage.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 This is a fully remote position, offering the flexibility to work from home on a full\-time basis.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Joining SMSGHM offers a chance to impact marginalised communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 32 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.
